declaration: Every choice below was made from train/val results only. This file is written
and committed BEFORE evaluate_test.py runs for the first time. The test split's
numbers for Phase 2D's MLP were already published in
docs/repair/showboat-ml/phase-2d/ before this phase started, so this comparison
is not perfectly blind and is not claimed to be; what is preserved is that no
architecture, width, learning rate, batch size, seed, calibration parameter,
ablation, or recommendation in this phase was chosen using test data.

selected_architecture.name: deepsets
selected_architecture.input_contract: [N, 68] float32 -> [N, 1] float32 logit (IDENTICAL to the Phase 2D artifact)
selected_architecture.why_this_config: best validation group-aware Spearman in search.py's 9-point grid (search.json), fastest to converge of the DS arms; deepsets_small (8,033 params) is statistically indistinguishable on validation and is reported as a cheaper alternative, but the frozen selection is not changed after the fact

baseline_for_comparison.primary: mlp_matched — Phase 2D's exact TinyNet(68, 32), retrained under this phase's identical minibatch protocol so no comparison is confounded by optimizer differences
baseline_for_comparison.historical_reference: Phase 2D's published full-batch numbers (val BCE 0.3703, val group-aware Spearman 0.3818; test 0.3744 / 0.3684) — cited, not re-derived
baseline_for_comparison.note: the matched-protocol MLP is STRONGER than Phase 2D's published MLP on validation, so the relational model is being compared against the better of the two MLPs, not the weaker one

training_protocol.early_stopping: patience 20 epochs on validation BCE, best checkpoint kept
training_protocol.loss: soft-label BCE against legal_pot_rate (identical target to Phase 2D)
training_protocol.calibration: two-parameter Platt (a, b) fit on validation predictions only, applied unchanged to test

recommendation_made_before_test.verdict: ADOPT the relational (Deep Sets) model, replacing the candidate-conditioned MLP
decision_rule_this_was_judged_against: meaningful improvement in at least one important dimension without unacceptable regression elsewhere

validation_evidence_supporting_it.double_bank_group_aware_spearman: 0.1916 +- 0.0132 vs 0.1238 +- 0.0333 (the predeclared weak point, +55% relative, and ~2.5x less seed variance)
validation_evidence_supporting_it.physics_budget_proxy: recall-of-best@5 0.774 vs the MLP needing k=8 for 0.781 — ~1.6x fewer candidates to simulate for equal quality
validation_evidence_supporting_it.seed_stability: equal or better across-seed std on every headline metric

accepted_costs.training_time: ~49s vs ~1.4s per seed (35x, both trivial in absolute terms)
accepted_costs.browser_inference: median 1.09-1.92 ms vs 0.040-0.043 ms per 24-candidate batch in onnxruntime-web (~30-45x), p95 2.6-6.7 ms, worst observed single call 12.9 ms — still 4-19x under the 50 ms budget and well below one physics rollout (~23 ms, derived from phase2c/perturbation_benchmark_results.json)

what_would_have_reversed_it: browser p95 latency at or above the 50 ms budget, or above the cost of a single physics rollout
ONNX export or onnxruntime-web parity failing
requiring a change to Team A's [N,68] input contract
any headline validation metric regressing versus the matched-protocol MLP

not_recommended_and_why.deepsets_attn: the attention/GNN arm matches plain Deep Sets within noise (val BCE 0.3414 +- 0.0004 vs 0.3423 +- 0.0003; group-aware Spearman 0.4733 +- 0.0046 vs 0.4700 +- 0.0073) for 1.7x the parameters and ~3.5x the training time — no justification for the extra machinery
not_recommended_and_why.deepsets_pot_id: adds the intended pot-ball id as a 69th input. Real but small gain (group-aware Spearman 0.4762 +- 0.0043 vs 0.4700). Requires changing encode.ts's feature contract, which is Team A's/the lead's call, not an engineering swap — flagged, not adopted
not_recommended_and_why.deepsets_small: statistically indistinguishable from the selected config on validation with 3x fewer parameters; kept out of the frozen selection only because the selection rule was fixed before these 5-seed numbers existed

evaluate_on_test_note: Evaluating several variants in one pass is not test-set tuning: the recommendation above is already fixed, and nothing downstream selects on these numbers. The ablations and controls are included so the report's test column is complete rather than selectively reported.
